properties.name: Name
properties.llmAllowKnxCommands: Allow AI to read KNX states and control actuators
properties.llmRequireCommandConfirmation: Ask for confirmation before sending KNX commands
properties.webAccessEnabled: Allow the AI to use the Web

promptContext.unlimited: No KNX AI limit (use model context)

messages.setupDoctorPromptsHint: Each suggestion opens the Web Assistant with a personalized, safe prompt. Nothing is executed automatically.
messages.setupDoctorDeployHint: Setup Doctor reads the last deployed flow. Deploy editor changes, then check again.
messages.webAccessHint: The model chooses this general Web tool semantically; no keywords or intent classifiers are used. External sites and the search service receive the query and this server’s public IP. Private KNX, camera, chat, memory and credential data are never added automatically.
messages.webProactiveHint: This separate opt-in also requires explicit instructions in AI Education and a destination learned from one normal chat request. The model decides what to check; existing tool permissions and KNX confirmation rules still apply.
messages.webBudgetHint: The rolling budget counts real outbound calls from chat and proactive checks.
messages.lmStudioContextInactive: Model inactive; Bionic defaults will be used on the first request
messages.lmStudioContextFailed: Unable to configure the model context
messages.promptContextHint: Controls how much KNX, memory, project and adapter context is sent to local models. Choose ‘No KNX AI limit’ to use the model's declared or active context window. It does not enable or disable tools and does not use intent routing.
messages.reasoningEffortHint: Optional preference for models that support reasoning effort. Automatic sends no preference; if a provider or model rejects the selected value, KNX AI retries without it.
messages.ollamaNotSupported: Ollama local mode: API key not required. Default endpoint is http://localhost:11434/api/chat.
messages.ollamaNoModels: No local Ollama model found. Install one or pick one from the library.
messages.ollamaInstallSteps: 1) Open the model library and copy the model name (for example llama3.1). 2) Put the name in the Model field and click Install it.
messages.chatContextUnavailable: The chat context summary is temporarily unavailable.
messages.chatLearningOpenHint: Open the Web UI directly on the shared CHAT learning editor to view, edit, copy or back up its persistent file.
messages.chatContextIntro: The chat automatically receives these sources. The paths below are the actual paths used by this Node-RED installation.
messages.chatContextLastPromptUnavailable: not available until the first chat request
messages.chatContextExactInputTokens: input tokens measured by the provider
messages.chatContextSourceKnxTraffic: Live KNX summary, anomalies, topology and selected telegrams.
messages.chatContextSourceAdapterHistory: Persistent daily history of automatically detected adapter events, including camera detections.
messages.chatContextSourceEtsProject: ETS semantics and the full Node-RED project inventory.
messages.chatContextSourceMemoryEducation: Session context, AI Education, bounded home memory and active plans.
messages.chatContextSourceCameras: Detected cameras and their available capabilities.
messages.chatContextFileChatContext: Persistent conversation turns, instructions and camera notification rules.
messages.chatContextFileHomeMemory: Bounded learned home memory only; AI Education remains in the node property.
messages.chatContextFileSchedules: Authoritative persistent runtime state for this node's plans and reminders.
messages.chatContextFileSchedulesReadable: Generated human-readable view of this node's plans and reminders.
messages.chatContextFileAssistantConfig: Persistent web Assistant configuration and semantic areas for this node.
messages.chatAdapterIntro: Choose a mapping preset to insert its input and output code. The list is loaded from the packaged chat-adapter mappings file; the generated code remains editable.
messages.chatAdapterCodeHelp: Mappings run synchronously. Return msg to continue or return no value to discard it. Errors are caught and reported without stopping Node-RED.
messages.homeIntelligenceIntro: The node builds a multilingual semantic ETS model. Proactive notifications are considered only when AI Education explicitly requests them; it never sends a KNX command proactively.
messages.aiEducationHelp: Only the user can edit this node property. Use it for durable guidance and proactive notification policies, including conditions, duration, quiet hours and repetition. The model reads it as authoritative guidance but never writes it. Facts and preferences requested in chat are stored in learned chat memory; one-time or recurring plans, reminders, monitoring and future commands are stored by the semantic scheduler. No trigger phrases or intent routing are required. Maximum 16,000 characters.

placeholder.aiEducation: Example: Keep replies short. Notify my most recent chat if a window stays open for 30 minutes; stay quiet between 23:00 and 07:00.
